---
title: "Research"
description: "We see aging as the accumulated residue of tissue repairs that were never completed. Damage that is not fully resolved leaves behind local niches — altered matrix, persistent senescent cells and failing regeneration — that arise at different times in different organs and reinforce themselves once formed. This makes aging a non-linear, mosaic process. We follow it from the niches where it begins, to the fate decisions of the cells within them, to the diseases they seed."
